basis: Two fresh subagents were asked to stay in their own folders. Access to other folders was not restricted. The coordinator staged both routes, supplied native tool locations, decoded all submissions, and ran the common viewer. No repair dimensions, algorithm, measurements or scorer feedback were supplied by the coordinator. The C179 blind-trial timing, cost and isolation claims are outside this run.

blender.timingDefinition: Filesystem interval from staging the ready workspace to writing the author report. Not model-active time. Agents could read the brief during staging.
